Provider integration boundaries and build fragments

disposition: ASR word-timestamp speech-rate proxy feasibility blocker; no ASR engine, adapter, licensed weight, runtime or result.

documented_context.source_finding: ASR word timestamps (words/min) are the most robust speech-rate proxy when an ASR path already exists; licence and commercial use depend on the chosen ASR.
documented_context.study: Semantic playback-speed chain prevalidation; Vosk gate plus Signalsmith/Bungee/Sonic actuators, Whisper tiny.en WER proxy.

exact_blockers.required_action: Pin the exact Vosk/Kaldi or sherpa-onnx/Whisper source revisions, stage the complete license, notice and attribution texts for the engine and bundled third parties, and record an independent license review.
exact_blockers.statement: No ASR source tree is staged at an exact 40-hex revision. The Vosk model README only states 'Copyright 2020 Alpha Cephei Inc'; the installed vosk 0.3.44 dist-info has no LICENSE and METADATA says 'License: UNKNOWN'. The sherpa-onnx 2.0.1 METADATA says Apache-2.0 but no upstream source revision or complete notice bundle is staged. A classifier or metadata string is not a grant.

exact_blockers.required_action: Supply the official model archives and tokenizer with byte counts and verified SHA-256, model cards, license/notice text, attribution and a written output-use and redistribution decision.
exact_blockers.statement: Model bytes are present but not licensed for this use. The Vosk tree has 14 files and no LICENSE, NOTICE or model card. The sherpa-onnx Whisper tiny.en tree has 9 files (including test wavs) and no LICENSE, README or model card. Neither has an official archive digest, source revision, commercial/output-use decision or reviewed attribution.

exact_blockers.required_action: Provide locked offline environments with exact package/wheel hashes, archives, install and import digests, deterministic threads and a clean-room offline load trace.
exact_blockers.statement: The runtime is a mutable, git-ignored .venv. There is no lockfile, wheel/sdist archive, install digest, deterministic thread policy or offline-load trace. No model or runtime was imported or executed here, so no load or inference result exists.

exact_blockers.required_action: Freeze a consented/rights-cleared cohort with adjudicated human word, filler and pause spans from at least two independent annotators, agreement, transcript and a reviewed output-use decision.
exact_blockers.statement: No rights-cleared audio with an independent word timing reference is staged. The two TTS clips carry construction-time labels from one synthetic voice; the AMI stitch has no transcript. There is no second annotator, adjudication, agreement statistic or reviewed AMI/CC BY 4.0 output-use decision. TTS labels are not an independent gold reference.

exact_blockers.required_action: Reproduce offline extraction and scoring with a frozen scorer, exact word/token accounting, finite checks, uniform-timing and no-alignment baselines, adverse/missing controls and a timestamp-tied pause/filler policy.
exact_blockers.statement: No word-timestamp or speech-rate result was reproduced. Recorded Vosk spans (121, 122 and 86 words) and batch gate times are provenance only. The study reports no words/min, boundary error, matched-word accounting, finite-output scan, uniform-timing baseline or timestamp-tied pause/filler preservation result.

exact_blockers.required_action: After model/data/runtime/quality gates clear, measure the exact paced workload, open a separate versioned OFF-by-default intake and obtain independent exact-head review.
exact_blockers.statement: No provider, tool, adapter or intake exists. There is no target-device streaming measurement, callback deadline, first-output or dropped/stale-event result, no OFF-by-default surface and no release review. The recorded batch gate wall time is not a device-timing result.

sherpa_whisper_tiny_en.license_recorded_in_study: MIT code / OpenAI model terms (evaluation only)

licensing.tts_construction_labels: synthetic; not an independent gold reference

non_claims: No ASR engine, model weight, tokenizer or runtime is imported, loaded or executed.
No audio, transcript, word span or annotation is read as a signal or scored.
No word timestamp, words/min, boundary, WER or finite-output result is reproduced.
No provider, registry, descriptor, public ABI, shared build or CI change exists.
No listening, device timing, benchmark, pipeline or release claim is made.
Recorded Vosk word counts and batch times are provenance, not evidence.
The synthetic arithmetic control can never qualify a candidate.

quality_outcomes.evidence: No reproduced boundary MAE, median or within-50 ms result.
No human reference or segmentation IoU/F1 result.
Recorded study WER is provenance only and has no local run.
The study reports no words/min; only a synthetic arithmetic control exists.
No matched-word accounting, finite scan or matched baseline exists.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: No rendered audio or source/output mapping exists.
No waveform, F0 or transient metric exists.
No playback chain, queue or fill/flush measurement exists.
Word timestamps are a rate proxy, not a stretcher.
Only two synthetic TTS clips and one unlabeled AMI stitch exist.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Include unfamiliar speech, music and silence.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: No stream, rebuffer, drift or partial-window measurement exists.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Include rebuffer, drift and the final partial window.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: No controller, source-timestamp policy or preservation metric exists.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Keep pause or filler decisions tied to source timestamps and measure speech preservation.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: Words/min alone is not a preferred-speed or acceptability policy.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Map output to a reviewed preferred-speed policy.

release_gates.reopen_condition: Pin exact source revisions and stage complete license, notice and attribution sets with an independent review.
release_gates.statement: Only research inputs are pinned. No ASR source revision is staged and no complete license/notice/attribution bundle is reviewed for Vosk/Kaldi, sherpa-onnx/Whisper or their bundled dependencies.
release_gates.title: source_revision_and_license_provenance

release_gates.reopen_condition: Supply official archives/tokenizer with verified byte counts and digests, model cards and reviewed rights.
release_gates.statement: Present model bytes are pinned by file and tree SHA-256, but the official archive digests, model cards, license text, attribution and output-use decision are absent.
release_gates.title: weights_tokenizer_and_digests

release_gates.reopen_condition: Provide locked offline environments and a clean-room offline load trace with exact package/import digests.
release_gates.statement: No locked offline runtime, package archives, import digests, deterministic thread policy or clean-room model load exists.
release_gates.title: pinned_runtime_and_offline_load

release_gates.reopen_condition: Stage the rights-cleared cohort, independent human reference, agreement statistics and output-use review.
release_gates.statement: No rights-cleared cohort with adjudicated multi-annotator word/filler/pause spans and transcript exists; TTS construction labels and unlabeled AMI audio do not satisfy this gate.
release_gates.title: rights_cleared_audio_and_independent_word_reference

release_gates.reopen_condition: Reproduce extraction and scoring with frozen scorers, exact accounting, finite checks and uniform/no-alignment baselines.
release_gates.statement: No reproduced boundary error, matched-word accounting, words/min rate estimate, finite/adverse scan or matched control baseline exists.
release_gates.title: word_timestamp_and_rate_accuracy_with_controls

release_gates.reopen_condition: Exercise the Rate profile on a composite path or record a reviewed waiver, and define a timestamp-tied pause/filler policy with a preservation metric.
release_gates.statement: The Rate profile is not exercised: no source/output mapping, duration, pitch/transient, buffering, rate change, unfamiliar speech/music/silence, rebuffer/drift, final partial window or timestamp-tied pause/filler preservation result exists.
release_gates.title: rate_profile_and_timestamp_tied_policy

release_gates.reopen_condition: Measure the installed candidate under paced workload with p50/p95/p99 latency, resources, deadlines and availability.
release_gates.statement: No target-device streaming latency, first-output, callback deadline, resource, thermal/energy or dropped/stale-event measurement exists; recorded batch times are context only.
release_gates.title: target_runtime_timing_resources_and_deadlines

release_gates.reopen_condition: Open a separate versioned OFF-by-default opt-in intake with exact descriptor/config, clean-install proof and exact-head review.
release_gates.statement: No provider/tool intake or public-surface decision exists. The installed v0 geometry, registry, default, shared build and CI are untouched.
release_gates.title: provider_intake_public_surface_and_release

required_artifacts.requirement: The exact research report, playback-speed README, validation and corpus scripts, corpus labels, recorded Vosk word spans and results, pinned by whole-file SHA-256.

Exact 40-hex source revisions and complete license/notice/attribution sets for the selected ASR engine (Vosk/Kaldi or sherpa-onnx/Whisper plus onnxruntime/CTranslate2), including bundled third-party notices.
Official model archives and tokenizer with archive byte counts and digests, a model card, license/notice text, attribution, commercial/output-use terms and an independent rights review.
Locked offline environments with exact wheel/sdist/conda hashes, archives, install/import digests, deterministic thread settings and a clean-room offline load trace.

Rights-cleared/consented speech audio plus adjudicated human word, filler and pause spans from at least two independent annotators, with agreement, transcript, meeting/channel mapping and reviewed output-use terms.
A fresh offline word-timestamp extraction and scoring run with frozen scorer, exact matched-word accounting, finite checks, uniform-timing and no-alignment baselines and adverse/missing controls.
A separate versioned OFF-by-default SDK provider/tool intake with exact descriptor/config, empty default settings, no registry/default/shared-build change and independent exact-head review.

required_results: Exact ASR source revisions with complete license/notice/attribution bundles.
Official model/tokenizer archives with verified byte counts and SHA-256.
Reviewed model cards and commercial/output-use decisions.
Locked offline runtimes with package and import digests.
Rights-cleared audio with adjudicated multi-annotator word/pause spans.
Reproduced word timestamps, boundary errors and words/min with matched-word accounting.
Uniform-timing and no-alignment baselines plus adverse/missing controls.
Rate-profile coverage or a reviewed waiver and a timestamp-tied pause/filler policy.
Target-device streaming timing, resources and deadlines.
Separate OFF-by-default provider/tool intake and independent exact-head review.

timing_requirements.evidence: No local model load or extraction was performed.
The recorded gate ran one batch call; no streaming timing exists.
No device, callback or dropped/stale-event measurement exists.
No CPU, memory, thermal or energy measurement exists.
